column3: Bug Description
The Heading and Subheading text boxes are missing character limits, allowing users to type infinite text.
The Heading and Subheading text boxes incorrectly allow fields to be filled with just empty spacebar hits.
The Banner Image upload field accepts invalid file formats instead of restricting uploads purely to images.
Clicking "Update Section" with only empty spaces typed into the Heading/Subheading fields throws no error message.
The Banner Image upload zone allows oversized files because it lacks a file size maximum limit rule.
The confirmation alert that pops up after saving changes displays static placeholder text rather than a real confirmation.
The Banner Image upload area does not show hint text telling the user what file extensions are allowed.
If a user deletes an uploaded banner image using the "X" button, they are unable to re-upload that same image file.
The title text field fails to clear or reset back to its default placeholder state after successfully updating a section.
Multiple page tabs (Home, About, Investors, etc.) let users save identical imagery and duplicate text across everything.
The "Why REYA" dropdown card remains wide open by default on page load instead of staying collapsed like the others.
Deleting a saved social impact card from the Admin Panel doesn't remove it; the item remains stuck on the live site.
Clicking on the "Loyalty Content" menu item accidentally forces the main page header to highlight itself out of nowhere.
Custom text labels entered for the graph's X-Axis and Y-Axis do not actually display on the public website chart.
Typing out a full string up to the character limit on this card causes the text to overlap and break the adjacent UI blocks.
The descriptive text strings beneath the safety icons overflow outside of their design borders and clip unreadably.
The file uploader accepts GIF files, but throwing an error message incorrectly stating that only IMG and SVG are allowed.
The system lacks an item limit counter, letting users add an infinite amount of security line items to the layout.
The "Join the Waitlist" action button inside the primary Hero section is completely dead or works only randomly.
Registration fails on click; the system crashes and throws an "investor creation failed" console exception block.
Submitting onboarding forms on Investor, Loyalty, or Messages tabs fails to record any data into the database sheet.
Completing Rider signup and clicking "Got It" redirects back home to a login modal instead of a successful dashboard state.
The primary "Invest in Reya" button located inside the welcome banner routes users to the completely wrong page URL.
The profile photo upload zone accepts document formats like PDFs and videos instead of restricting it to standard images.
The Password and Phone Number entry boxes accept standalone spacebar taps as valid entries instead of blocking them.
Onboarding submission forms for Rider and Driver tiers completely lack data format validation on Name, Phone, or Email.
The Investment Amount text field allows users to leave it empty when it is supposed to be a mandatory input row.
Red validation errors stay stuck on screen even after the user successfully selects a choice from the Investment Tier menu.
Smooth page slide-in transition animations are completely broken or missing across several layout tiles.
The Create Password and Confirm Password text entry rows accidentally render two overlapping reveal eye icons.
The Driver Name field accepts long text blocks past the limit despite a label notice explicitly claiming a max of 30.
When a user uploads their identification documents as a PDF file, the thumbnail container fails to generate a visual preview.
In the Driver registration form, tapping the "Terms of Service" text label checks the box for the prompt above it instead.
The Rider form pops up a generic "Full Name required" toast alert, but fails to show inline red error text directly under the input.
The Driver registration submission forms lack error validation alerts across every input box field.
Clicking the "I confirm I have read terms..." text string checks off the entirely wrong agreement checkbox sitting above it.
Selecting an item from the "Select Your Inquiry" dropdown list fails to dismiss the active "Field Required" error label.
Forms filled out across Investor, Loyalty, or Contact portals completely fail to push data rows to the backend storage sheet.
The Profile Photo upload button lets users click past it without any validation enforcement or file-type checks.
The system allows users to bypass the Investment Amount field when it needs to be locked down as a required field.
User registration attempts fail globally while flashing an "investor creation failed" red toast message block.
Navigating to the Rider form fires an empty phone validation alert immediately before the user even has a chance to type.
The quick auto-navigation dashboard button helper is completely missing from the live interface view.
When dispatching a ride request connection to an available driver, the ETA counter stays frozen at "0 min pickup."
Opening the support complaint screen in Dark Mode makes the complaint category selection text invisible against the dark background.
An unneeded "Pay Now" checkout button renders on screen during contexts where no active balances or fees apply.
Tapping on a incoming message toast notification alert fails to open the conversation or route users to the chat screen.
The UI notification text reading "Driver arrived to your location" has zero spacing padding, crashing up against the edges.
Clicking site navigation links for the very first time fires a loading wheel spinner, but clicking them a second time does nothing.
The "Invest in Réya" and "Waitlist" layout items show loading spinners only on first use, skipping loading animations on repeat clicks.
The footer "Sign Up" hyperlink is non-functional because it doesn't point to any target page destination.
Clicking the footer "Feedback" link fails to jump or smoothly scroll the window down to where the feedback component lives.
Tapping the footer "Support" redirect option does not anchor scroll users to the Help Desk connection channel cards.
The support email hyperlink (support@reyaapp.com) located inside the footer layout is dead and unclickable.
Submitting the account creation form updates the user profile but fails to reset the Investment Tier selection back to empty.
The Rider registration form accepts valid JPG files but breaks anyway with a "Please upload a valid image or PDF" error.
All support communication channel navigation links are completely dead and do not adapt or respond on tap events.
The error indicator text reading "Please select a country code" shows up even when a valid country code is selected.
Email entries do not auto-convert to lowercase before hitting databases, causing login errors if capitalized.
The Vehicle Info setup panels pre-load random default data rows instead of presenting a completely clean input wizard.
The application lacks a visual confirmation message stating "OTP sent successfully" once a mobile code is dispatched.
The Forgot Password window lets users trigger the "Resend OTP" button infinitely without a rate limit cooldown lock.
Launching the Set New Password view automatically forces the phone keyboard overlay open, blocking the layout views.
Profiles manually generated inside the admin panel render default "DP" initials text instead of pulling profile pictures.
Profile pictures uploaded via web accounts fail to pass over and sync to the user avatar zones inside the mobile app.
Entering a single symbol into the Vehicle Number field crashes the view with a "Something went wrong" block instead of a validation error.
Subscriptions purchased via web layouts fail to activate or display when the user logs into the mobile app dashboard.
Updating a user's contact email address via the admin table breaks the account loop; login OTPs continue going to the old email.
The login inputs auto-fill old text data that triggers a false "Account not found" blocker code when clicking submit.
The profile picture upload element is an absolute requirement for registration, but it lacks a red asterisk indicator.
The registration input field accepts invalid email handles starting with consecutive dots (e.g., ..user@email.com).
Tapping the log out button cleanly clears active user session instances but throws no visual feedback confirmation popup.
Entering a blank space inside the country code lookup prompt completely wipes out all visible search results list options.
Typing text into the password entry box causes two visibility eye toggle icons to render directly on top of each other.
If a user profile has no active mobile number recorded, the field line stays empty instead of displaying a clean "N/A."
Unsubscribed users incorrectly see a "Complete Payment" link which errors out with "planId is required" on click.
Switching the core application preference settings to Spanish fails to translate text layers across the main app views.
Confirming a phone number change via OTP fires two duplicate success banners and leaves the modal open instead of closing it.
Tapping the "Update Membership" button forces the user's viewport window to instantly scroll down to the bottom of the page.
Upgrading a plan triggers a false "User already has an active or pending subscription" alert block, blocking payment checkout.
Upgrades show a "User already has active subscription" error, yet checking profile details shows the plan updated without any payment.
Driver signups can bypass validation by filling out the License and Plate fields entirely with special characters like #@$.
Inline validation error labels stay stuck on screen even after the user fixes the error and inputs valid information.
The password recovery pipeline is blocked because the system never presents an OTP verification field after emailing the reset link.
The subscription management dash shows an "Active" status badge even when the attached checkout payment transaction fails.
The phone registration loop completely rejects authentic, accurate verification OTP codes input by new users.
Red warning text messages fail to disappear after the user corrects their Driver and Vehicle identification numbers.
Character constraint checks for Driver and License fields run only during final form submission instead of checking in real-time.
The safety countdown timer ("drive to get off the app") stays frozen instead of updating its remaining hours in real-time.
When clicking the App Coming Soon button on the homepage, the highlighted home navigation link unexpectedly unselects itself during a silent page reload.

Clicking the Invest in Réya button in the header correctly redirects to the Express Your Interest form, but clicking the exact same button located in the video playback section incorrectly redirects to the header section of the investors page instead.
Clicking the SignUp link in the footer newsletter category fails to open a registration screen or modal, incorrectly redirecting the user straight back to the top of the homepage instead.

Submitting invalid characters or leaving the newsletter email field blank throws a broken raw code error reading "Unexpected token '<', 'DOCTYPE'... is not valid JSON" instead of a proper validation warning.
Clicking the Cookie Settings link in the webpage footer causes the screen to silently refresh rather than opening the cookie configuration panel.
The support email link requires multiple clicks to trigger a response before it will successfully launch and redirect to Gmail.
Clicking on the LinkedIn social media icon fails to connect, causing the target webpage to stall out and completely fail to load.
The title thumbnail image is cropped incorrectly, clipping off awkwardly against the border radius design parameters of the container.

Submitting the Express Your Interest form with completely valid entries throws a broken raw code error reading "Unexpected token '<', 'DOCTYPE'... is not valid JSON" instead of showing a success state.
Clicking on the Purchase Plan button for any subscription tier inside the plan modal fails to trigger the checkout process and nothing loads on screen.
The Rider Subscription Form displays an unnecessary, empty input bar field directly beneath the profile photo upload section.
Submitting the Rider Subscription form with accurate details throws a system breakdown error reading "Unexpected token 'I', 'Internal S'... is not valid JSON" instead of saving the data.
The registration system lets users completely bypass the profile photo field and submit the Rider Subscription form without uploading an image.

Submitting the Driver Subscription form after completing all mandatory rows fails to route to the next step, throwing a raw database error reading "Unexpected token 'I', 'Internal S'... is not valid JSON."

The system allows drivers to bypass validation rules and successfully submit registration forms while leaving mandatory fields like Driving License, Vehicle Registration, Vehicle Insurance, and Training Certificates completely empty.
Leaving the City and Select Track dropdown choices on their default placeholder settings fails to trigger any visual error messages during driver registration submission.
The email support navigation link responds slowly and requires multiple taps to launch a mail client, while the Call Center and Live Support links fail to route users anywhere.

Submitting a message via the Send Us a Message form with completely valid inputs fails to push through, displaying a raw system code exception reading "Unexpected token '<', 'DOCTYPE'... is not valid JSON."
Submitting a valid email address to trigger a password reset links blocks the recovery pipeline, flashing a raw code error message reading "Unexpected token '<', 'DOCTYPE'... is not valid JSON."

When the browser view is zoomed in to 250%, clicking the expanded navigation menu icon breaks scrolling limits, locking the screen and preventing users from scrolling down to view hidden navigation links.
